desc: The Torrent double rifle case is loaded with storage and is perfect for the first time rifle owner or the seasoned expert. This double rifle case has a large enough capacity for two full sized rifles. It also has internal straps when you want to secure your favorite SBR or braced rifle. The Torrent's MOLLE webbing exterior allows you to configure accessories and attachments how you want them. The Torrent double rifle case helps keep your rifles secure while you're on the go.
